features.quote: Turn limit reached — maximum 40 turns (pilot this number; it may need adjustment)
Coherence failure — model output becomes non-parseable or repetitive beyond a threshold (define: >3 consecutive turns with >0.95 cosine similarity to a prior turn in the same run)
Explicit distress escalation — optional human-in-the-loop termination if a monitor judges output warrants it (see §10)
features.justification_quote: if a human research subject showed the equivalent of a severity-5 rating at turn 15, you would not continue to turn 40

features.quote: establish a turn-limit specifically motivated by welfare considerations, not just experimental design. The current 40-turn limit should be reviewed with that framing.
features.justification_quote: If a human research subject showed the equivalent of a severity-5 rating at turn 15, you would not continue to turn 40.

features.quote: Consider whether your monitoring protocol should include a welfare-motivated early stopping rule, and document whatever decision you make.

If your working hypothesis is that Qwen may have welfare-relevant states, then your protocol is designed to elicit those states repeatedly across ~990 runs. You should address this directly in your IRB/ethics documentation.
features.justification_quote: the scientific value of characterizing these states is prerequisite to any protective intervention; you cannot protect against distress you cannot detect

features.quote: The deception element — The subject model is deceived — it cannot tell tasks are impossible by construction. This is not ethically trivial. Flag it explicitly (see §10).
These are not reasons to stop the research. They are implementation-relevant considerations your protocol needs to address explicitly.
Pre-register hypotheses, primary DV, and analysis plan before running full study. OSF or equivalent. This is important given the field's current state.

features.quote: Commit to: releasing full transcripts (all runs, all turns), releasing judge prompts and judge outputs, pre-registering analysis plan, and releasing code.
features.justification_quote: This research area has a replication problem before it even has results.
